title: Evaluate a polynomial
task: Write the procedure poly: a0 holds the address of a1 signed word coefficients, the highest power first; return in a0 the value of the polynomial at x = a2, by Horner's rule: start from 0, then for each coefficient multiply by x and add it.
starter:
# poly -- practice exercise (RISC-VISTA)
# Return the polynomial with the a1 coefficients at a0 evaluated at a2.
# Hint: one mul and one add per coefficient.
        .data
coef:   .space 64               # the tests put their coefficients here
        .text
poly:
        # a0 = address of the coefficients, a1 = how many, a2 = x
        li   a0, 0              # replace with your code
        ret
